title: writing-aids.spec:21 focus mode flakes (pre-existing)
description: Fails 3/5 on the T168 build and 1/5 on the pre-split build (ui3-wordsplit/pw-flakes.log, pw-focus-old.log): p.nth(1) lacks focus-dim right after ArrowUp/Home; likely the Tiptap focus race fixed in pages.spec by T165. Test-only fix expected.

review.note: Diff is test-only and sound (polls DOM selection into paragraph 0 before enabling Focus mode, removing the race). My rerun on a private build: 1/1 completed pass, remaining repeats stalled in teardown under machine load avg ~500 (no failure observed); owner's 7/8 + this pass are statistical evidence only (CLAIMED).
